title: Cellar and Visitor
author: Dominic Galloway
blurb: Sable Whitlock, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must return what was taken in 1974 before the last resident signs the papers.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
